description: You are a tax compliance analyst at Ironclad Industrial Supply, a B2B equipment distributor. Create a Product Tax Class named 'Industrial Machinery'. Create two tax rates: 'California State Tax' for US/CA at 7.25%, and 'New York State Tax' for US/NY at 4.00% (both with wildcard zip). Create a Tax Rule named 'Industrial Equipment Tax Rule' linking customer class 'Taxable Goods' to the 'Industrial Machinery' product class with both state rates selected, priority 0. Save all three items. Data sources: California BOE base rate 7.25% (2017); New York State Dept. of Taxation base rate 4.00%. If not logged in, use admin/Admin1234!.
